Class CardFactory

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.presentation.UIComponent
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.presentation.shared.CardFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
StyledView
@Component public class CardFactory extends UIComponent
Factory for the dashboard stat cards row, and for library grid cards (album / song cards used in My Library grid views).

The two Consumer parameters are intentionally kept. DashboardController passes them and removing them would break compilation there.

Album art performance:

  • Images are decoded at a small fixed size (CARD_WIDTH) rather than at their full embedded resolution. JavaFX's Image constructor downsamples during decode when width/height are supplied, which is dramatically cheaper than decoding full-resolution art and scaling it down in the UI afterward.
  • Decoded Image objects are cached per album-art file path in artCache, so re-opening a view or re-sorting the grid never re-decodes art that was already loaded once this session.

  • Field Details

    • CARD_WIDTH

      public static final double CARD_WIDTH
      Fixed pixel size (both width and height) for library grid card art. Kept as a single constant so every card in the grid is the same size, which is what lets TilePane lay them out evenly with consistent gaps.

      When a user-adjustable icon size setting is added, this can become a mutable field / passed-in parameter instead of a constant — the cache keys on file path only, so varying requested size per call would need the cache key to include size too. Not needed until that feature exists.
